_note: Daily audio brief (ElevenLabs text-to-speech). voiceId is the custom 'Waynesville News' voice. modelId eleven_v4_turbo (chosen by the editor after side-by-side samples): on the 121k-credit plan that is about 550,000 characters a month, so a ~3-minute (3,000-character) daily script uses about a sixth. eleven_v4 is the non-Turbo option at about half the characters. maxChars hard-caps each script. minCreditsLeft: skip the day (don't fail) if fewer credits remain. outputFormat mp3_44100_64 keeps a 3-minute file near 1.4 MB. voiceSettings are passed to ElevenLabs. enabled: the daily-audio workflow records only when true. The script comes from src/content/audio/<date>.txt when the daily run writes one, otherwise it is built from the brief. Recordings are listed in audio-index.json. The API key lives only in the ELEVENLABS_API_KEY repository secret. intro/outro: style A music (warm acoustic guitar and light piano) generated with ElevenLabs music and chosen by the editor; make-audio wraps each recording in them with ffmpeg (skipped if ffmpeg or the files are missing). housePromo: read in the sponsor slot (before the sign-off) on days no supporter has an audio line; set it to "" to drop it. Flagging a story for the episode: add podcast: true to a published story's frontmatter (src/content/stories/) to have it read in the next episode within 7 days of its date, once; or podcast: "YYYY-MM-DD" for a specific day. It reads the title and dek, or podcastText if given, and room is reserved for it under maxChars so it is never cut. Voice rotation: voices lists the voices (id, name, optional voiceSettings) read in turn, one per day, starting with the first on voiceRotationStart; voiceId stays the default and the fallback if a rotation voice fails. Each episode records its voice in audio-index.json.

podcast._note: Show pages in podcast apps. Each link appears in the brief Listen box and the site footer once filled in; leave blank to hide.
